event.description: Retain reversed padded operands but restore two d=14, two-head transformer blocks and use ff=19, with rank-3 learned positions and the 45000-step learning-rate-floor schedule.
event.proposal: Family: token representation. Retained incumbent is 3185 parameters at 99.990000%, a +0.990000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: no accepted token-representation substitution; the most recent failed result is attempt-0033, reversed operands plus one block, an optimization failure peaking at 2.4% validation; 2 prior token-representation attempts. The immediately preceding d=13 one-head attempt-0032 is an optimization failure (45000 steps, peak 83.7% validation followed by decline, no checkpoint), not a scored nonqualification. Hypothesis: reversing operands may require both retained attention stages even if it does not support the one-layer compression; paired with the nearest ff=19 width reduction, it tests whether the representation can still support a smaller two-layer model (3185 to 3129 parameters). This is a token-representation substitution plus feed-forward-width compression, not parameterization-preserving scalar pruning. It is more informative than restoring two blocks at unchanged ff=20 because it directly resolves whether the reordering can support a qualifying reduction rather than only a non-retainable control.
